title: Apple Watch app?
body:
Dear developers,

You’ve made a fantastic app but I’m really looking forward to an Apple Watch app as it’ll be much convenient by logging out habits from the watch as I’m really trying to minimise my iPhone usage time and instead trying to detoxify with the help of the watch
Kindly lemme know if you’re working on the watch app and I’ll be the first one to buy this app 

Regards
Fawad
author: Fadizinbox

body: The design is so cool! Loved the user interface as well as the functionality.
